title: The global cocycle square for an ordinary coefficient map
statement: Let f:X→S, q:Y→T, g:T→S and p:Y→X commute, and let φ:F→p_*M be an ordinary coefficient h-map. For n≥0 let e:Hⁿ(Rg_*Rq_*(M[0]))→g_*Hⁿ(Rq_*(M[0])) satisfy the canonical local class equation [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. Write α=derivedSquareUnitMap(f,q,g,p,φ) [lem-weil-pbc-derived-square-unit-map]. The total-derived Leray edge of φ* x equals the whole-open restriction from g⁻¹S to T of (Hⁿ(α);e) applied to the total-derived Leray edge of x. Here φ* is moduleCohomologyFMap and both total-derived Leray edges are the chosen classical edges transported by schemeSingleCohomologyComparison. No derived pullback or cohomological upper bound is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the canonical restrictedDirectImageMap with the restricted h-map supplied by moduleCohomologyFMap_restriction, using injectivity of the restriction adjunction hom equivalence and cancellation of the pushforward composition isomorphism. This gives the restriction square on cohomology.
Choose injective resolutions and their restricted-resolution section comparisons at f inverse top and p inverse f inverse top, and apply derivedSquareUnit_localClasses.

Precompose by the source cohomology restriction. The two applications of lerayEdge_restrictedResolution and the cohomology restriction square identify the local equation with the classical global Leray equation. Postcompose with the inverse total/classical comparison and restrict g inverse top to top. Cancel the comparison and its inverse, using naturality.

theorem globalLeray_unitSquare
    {X S Y T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (q : Y ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) (p : Y ⟶ X)
    (hs : p ≫ f = q ≫ g) (F : X.Modules) (M : Y.Modules)
    (φ : F ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M) (n : ℕ)
    (e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor.{w, u, u + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M)) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
          (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M)))
    (he : ∀ V : S.Opensᵒᵖ,
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass S.toRingedSpace (n : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M))).app V ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)).map e).hom.app V =
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom (n : ℤ)
        (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M)).hom.app V ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeInverseLocalClass g.toLRSHom.toShHom (n : ℤ)
        (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M)).app V)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace n).obj F) :
    (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace).map
        (globalLerayComparison.{u, w} q M n).inv
          (((Classical.choose (exists_lerayEdge_isIso_of_vanishing q)) n).app M
            (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap p φ n x)) =
      (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
          (globalLerayImage.{u, w} q M)).val.presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (congrArg op (Opens.map_top g.base).symm) :
        op (g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : S.Opens)) ⟶ op (⊤ : T.Opens)))
          (Hom.app ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).map
              (globalLerayUnitMap f q g p hs F M φ) ≫ e) ⊤
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace).map
              (globalLerayComparison.{u, w} f F n).inv
                (((Classical.choose (exists_lerayEdge_isIso_of_vanishing f)) n).app F x)))
